# Fix PR #754 (automated flake.lock bump): HA openFirewall removed upstream

You are on the PR's branch (`update_flake_lock_action`). CI fails with exactly
one real error — the other host jobs are fail-fast cancellations of this one:

```
Failed assertions:
- The option definition `services.home-assistant.openFirewall' in
  hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix no longer has any effect; please remove it.
  The frontend port is not configured in YAML any more and therefore cannot be
  determined at eval time any longer.
```

The nixpkgs bump removed `services.home-assistant.openFirewall`.

## Fix

In `hosts/classic-laddie/default.nix`, Home Automation section (~line 837):
1. Remove `openFirewall = true;` from `services.home-assistant`.
2. Open the port explicitly right there, keeping the locality:
   `networking.firewall.allowedTCPPorts = [ 8123 ];`
   The port is statically known because this config pins
   `http.server_port = 8123` a few lines below. One terse comment line: the
   module lost openFirewall (port no longer eval-time knowable upstream), so
   the config opens the port it pins itself.

Do NOT touch flake.lock or anything else. If `nix flake check` then surfaces
another NEW assertion from the lock bump, fix it in the same minimal spirit
and say so in your report; deprecation *warnings* (e.g. stdenv.isLinux from
upstream) are not yours to fix.

## Acceptance

- `nix flake check` passes — paste the final lines.
- `nix build --dry-run .#nixosConfigurations.classic-laddie.config.system.build.toplevel`
  evaluates cleanly.
- Commit to the current branch and push (this updates PR #754). Do not open a
  new PR, do not merge.
